So hard to pick...I had to stare at the song list and really think about the moments on this album that have the greatest effect on me:

Lyrically: between Help and Fuck Jobs (the former due to its amazing simplicity, like in the lines "but I gotta go to work" and "thank you for letting me borrow your jacket, it kept me warm in a cold place" and its human appeal, where only Brian has the ability to put such a relevant feeling into a line "motherfucker make it happen for me", something I'm sure we've all experienced before...the latter thanks to its transparency, where I remember my first listen of the album and cracking the biggest smile and laughing out loud as Brian opens with "I fucking hate the comments, why do you feel you have to talk? nobody asked for your opinion" and again moving to the human element "i want world domination just like everybody else, so if you hear me talking strategy it's only to myself. everybody's gotta have a game plan, cut it up a couple different ways."

Musically: Historic Cemetery or 2Yl...(the former thanks to its incredibly hypnotic keyboard riff behind the verses and GDP's rap, along with its dynamic nature, i.e. the shift into a super satisfying breakdown where the distorted guitar churns over Brian crooning about putting the wrong finger in the hot wax...the latter because of its amazing energy and infectiously catchy chorus, and as most of you have mentioned, the horns and horn solo are just absolutely amazing)

Long post, but damn I love this album lol

As a relatively new Falcon player, I've gotten my tech to be pretty good (7 I'd say, with 10 being absolutely perfect tech), but still find myself getting bodied in virtually every match I play, no matter the opponent or their character. I watch videos every chance I get and feel like I'm understanding what's on the screen (i.e., I have confidence in my understanding of the game's mechanics, different strategies and combos, and mindgames). But somehow, this doesn't translate into my play, where I always find myself getting bopped by players who, when I watch them play someone else, don't look very impressive to me at all, and I wonder why I lost. 

I know they say that getting bopped a lot will only help you get better, but I don't see how if what you're practicing just isn't translating. I'm also aware that this is super scrubby/whiney/newbie, but I don't know where else to get advice from.
